chronology: Retrospective fairness sensitivity requested after both main cohorts had been scored. Grid fixed before computing any new restricted-history supports. Every specified history/width is reported. No additional independent test cohort.

gas.history_meaning: training labels for native selector, cumulative batches 1 through the stated number. Final predictor fitted on batches 1-7, tested on 8, 9, 10 as originally. Primary equal-batch mean of present-class macro recall, secondary equal-batch mean accuracy and OVR AUC.

har.history_meaning: 15 original inner fit people using saved row indices, or all 21 official training people. Final predictor fitted on all 21, tested on nine original people. Primary equal-subject mean accuracy, secondary pooled accuracy and macro OVR AUC.

selectors: Original native sklearn RFE, same XGBoost gain, 20% of original feature width per step, default per-iteration refits; native sklearn SelectKBest(f_classif). Univariate controls retained at their original Gas widths. No ANOVA arm in the original HAR protocol.
predictor: Same 100-round depth-4 XGBClassifier as in both initial studies, CPU hist, learning rate 0.1, one thread, seed 20421. Measurements finite. A median imputer is fitted only on selector history for Gas. Apply original final refit with all eligible historical rows. Keep feature representations fixed.
check: For each full-history control compare selected indices and all probabilities with the original archived runs. Prespecified primary contrasts use original 5-column maximin and 6-column vote (Gas) or 22-column separating vote (HAR). Preserve all predictions, supports, times, separate unit and dataset endpoints. Report descriptive comparisons only, no optimization over histories.
